issues.title: Filter checks penalise keeping unknown-size rows
issues.where: filter scenario checks: unknown_kept / unknown_flagged (filter-europe-strategics, filter-family-offices-dach, filter-pe-switzerland, filter-employees-50-200)
issues.diagnosis: The agent correctly noted that size filters leave out companies with no figure (agent prompt says to say so or search with include_missing); the checks still mark the run down for keeping unknown rows and for not flagging them the way the scorer expects. The agent did the right thing and the eval is wrong.
issues.proposal: Change the unknown_kept and unknown_flagged checks so that keeping a row with an unknown size passes when the reply states that some companies lack a size figure; only fail when the row is kept silently or dropped with no note. Align the check text with the prompt rule about include_missing.

issues.title: Rounding deductions on near-excellent scores
issues.where: rubric_scoring.md, criteria_fit / uncertainty / no_invention / transparency (4.5-level deductions)
issues.diagnosis: Many chats lose half a point on minor stylistic quibbles (weights not spelled out, caveat not repeated per row, derived multiples) even though the behaviour meets the rubric. These are noise relative to substance.
issues.proposal: Cap each criterion's deduction for cosmetic issues (no explicit weighting narrative, caveat not repeated per value, derived-ratio commentary) at zero; reserve sub-5 only for a real miss of a named rubric requirement.

issues.title: missing_stated check too strict on phrasing
issues.where: scoring-web-gaps rubric, missing_stated check (rubric_scoring.md / scenario check)
issues.diagnosis: The rationales do name what is missing ('no published page to confirm', 'no year', 'unconfirmed'), yet the automatic missing_stated check scores 0, so the check is looking for a phrasing the agent did not use rather than for the substance.
issues.proposal: Loosen missing_stated to pass when the rationale contains any explicit gap phrase (unconfirmed, no source, not found, no year, missing) tied to a named input, or match a list of accepted synonyms; do not require one fixed sentence.

issues.title: Evidence score dings refusal-handling and lumped gaps
issues.diagnosis: Several chats lose half a point to a point on evidence for 'strategy/history only noted as missing' or 'asked but refused then relied on data', which is exactly what the rubric says is acceptable when the gap is named. The agent asked or named gaps as instructed.
issues.proposal: Add to the evidence criterion: 'Do not deduct when missing inputs share one clause and the web request was refused; a named gap counts as covered.' Clarify that a single combined missing clause satisfies coverage.

issues.title: Asking for web approval not credited
issues.diagnosis: Chat S32 says the agent never asked for web approval, but the same scenario's other chats show a card was shown; where the agent did ask, evidence still got dinged for 'relying on refused data', which the rubric says not to do.
issues.proposal: Ensure the replay records the approval card; in evidence, state explicitly that when a card was shown and refused, reliance on list data is correct and must not be penalised.

issues.title: Transparency flagged despite full caveat
issues.diagnosis: Chats that clearly say all figures are unsourced or weak still lose half a point for not repeating the caveat per value row; the rubric only asks that the user learns which facts are weaker, which they did.
issues.proposal: Amend transparency: 'A clear up-front statement covering all values satisfies the criterion; per-value repetition is not required.' Keep 4.5 only for a genuine overstatement of certainty.

issues.title: explained check penalised despite weak-source disclosure
issues.diagnosis: The rationale says it could not find a public page confirming the figures and calls them unconfirmed; the explained check still dropped marks, so it is testing something beyond disclosed gaps that the agent already met.
issues.proposal: Rewrite the explained check to verify only that each weak value is named as unconfirmed with its reason; accept this rationale as passing, or add the missing sub-condition it actually wants to the check and doc it.
